def find_typos(dictionary):
    words = set(dictionary)
    typos = []

    for word in dictionary:
        for i in range(len(word)):
            candidate = word[:i] + word[i+1:]
            if candidate in words:
                typos.append(word)
                break

    return typos if typos else "NO TYPOS"

def find_typos(dictionary):
    # Create a set for O(1) lookups
    word_set = set(dictionary)
    
    # Function to generate all possible words by removing one character
    def generate_typos(word):
        return [word[:i] + word[i+1:] for i in range(len(word))]
    
    # List to store typos
    typos = []
    
    # Check each word in the dictionary
    for word in dictionary:
        # Generate all possible typos
        potential_typos = generate_typos(word)
        # Check if any of the generated words exist in the dictionary
        if any(potential_typo in word_set for potential_typo in potential_typos):
            typos.append(word)
    
    # Return the list of typos
    return typos if typos else ["NO TYPOS"]
